shared_elements: figures shown frontally/in profile with clearly defined head, torso and limbs
repeated patterned rows suggesting curls, feathers or pleats
justification: A shows a procession of bearded human figures in profile wearing tall headdresses and long robes, one touching another's shoulder, while B is a single frontal bird-headed creature with outspread wings and human-like hands; the only real correspondence is a generic anthropomorphic body with rows of stylised repeated detail (curls/beard versus feathers). There is no shared composition, no shared relationship between figures, and the modes of depiction (narrative profile row versus isolated symmetrical emblem) are fundamentally different.
